name: Automation Faults
query:
SELECT
	COALESCE(NULLIF(method, ''), '(no method)')   AS "Reason:Data:430",
	SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)     AS "24h:Int:70",
	SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)       AS "7d:Int:70",
	COUNT(*)                                      AS "Retained:Int:95",
	MAX(creation)                                 AS "Last seen:Datetime:170"
FROM `tabError Log`
WHERE method LIKE 'automation%%'
   OR method LIKE 'workflow%%'
   OR method LIKE 'voice%%'
   OR method LIKE '%%tatva\\_connect.automation%%'
   OR method LIKE '%%tatva\\_connect.workflow\\_engine%%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC
